description: This file is a Python source code for a conversational bot that integrates multiple services such as speech-to-text, text-to-speech, language model, and video avatar. It sets up a pipeline for handling client connections, processing user input, generating responses, and managing session interactions.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the processing pipeline for orchestrating various steps involved in the conversational bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates the pipeline with its parameters and execution behavior.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Holds configuration options for a pipeline, such as metrics and timeouts.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Maintains the context for interactions with the language model.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Associates the LLM context with user-specific parameters and strategies.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters related to user behavior and turn strategies for the LLM context.

classes.name: UserTurnStrategies
classes.description: Defines strategies for managing user turns, including stop conditions.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy that determines when to stop user input analysis based on a turn analyzer.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract class defining the transport interface for input and output channels.

classes.name: DailyTransport
classes.description: Transport implementation that supports daily streaming with adaptive bitrate settings.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up services, constructs the processing pipeline, and handles client connection events to run the conversational bot.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point for initializing the transport and starting the bot logic.
